text.en: Meena read the words liberty, equality, fraternity. "Where did they come from?" she asked.

The age of revolutions changed the world. The American Revolution (1776) freed thirteen colonies from Britain, and the Declaration of Independence spoke of equal rights. The French Revolution (1789) began against the king's rule and high taxes and declared liberty, equality and fraternity.
Napoleon rose to power in France and spread revolutionary ideas, but he was defeated at Waterloo in 1815. The Latin American countries won independence from Spain and Portugal under leaders such as Simon Bolivar.
These revolutions inspired people everywhere to demand rights and ended old monarchies in many places.

text.en: The idea of liberty, equality and fraternity.
